additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412295-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312569868/22]-strips on screen CRM:01282000909 [EQM 1179035 | NCR6971]
additional_info.body:
Hello Vaishnavy,
We have contacted the display supplier.
This issue can be fixed by replacing the PCBA V1.1 with the PCBA V1.3a.
However, this might be a difficult operation to do in the field since there are a lot of components to be disassembled to get to the PCB in the blackpanel.
The easiest way might be to replace the entire display.
With best regards,
